text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki crown that had forever remained out of reach.
On that day, for the first time, to House Mejiro—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright takes a commanding victory!!
In the long, storied history of the Mejiros, her first crown is finally claimed!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaaaah, Bright, Bright,
Brighttttt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You're incredible, just incredible...
How could you be this amazing, truly...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... you look so happy...
*sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Sister Ryan,
thank you so much for watching over me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Light to Mejiro...
And Ryan-onesama's sorrow... today, I finally...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorrow...?
Bright, what do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: Basically, this is what it means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told Mejiro Ryan about Mejiro Bright's hidden feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what happened.
Thank you, Bright. But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to shoulder everything yourself.
If you take on too much, you'll end up
just like I did."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Like Sister Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think the reason I couldn't run
the Triple Crown races very well
was because I put way too much pressure on myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So Bright, please run for yourself.
That's what's best for the Mejiro family, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright's happiness is the most important thing of all.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hauwaa... Big sister Ryan~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I... really do adore this so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that about!?
Well, I'm glad they look up to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, let's stay focused for the Nippon Derby, too! I'm counting on you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do this together again.
Yeah, let's do this together again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby...
I still can't see the path I should take..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Should I keep running like this?
Or should I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho was a battle fought for yesterday.
However, the Japan Derby is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like this will be a battle for each of their tomorrows.
